definitions.explanation: The fundamental or most important characteristic of something.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}の{本質|ほんしつ}を{見極|みきわ}める。
examples.english: Identify the essence of the problem.

examples.japanese: {本質的|ほんしつてき}な{違|ちが}いは{何|なん}ですか。
それは{本質|ほんしつ}を{捉|とら}えていない。

notes:
{本質|ほんしつ} refers to the fundamental nature or core characteristic of something.

WORD FORMATION:
{本|ほん} (root, main) + {質|しつ} (quality, nature)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {本質|ほんしつ}を{見極|みきわ}める: to discern the essence
- {本質|ほんしつ}を{捉|とら}える: to grasp the essence
- {本質|ほんしつ}を{理解|りかい}する: to understand the essence
- {本質|ほんしつ}に{迫|せま}る: to get to the heart of
- {本質的|ほんしつてき}な: essential, fundamental
- {本質的|ほんしつてき}に: essentially

USAGE:
Common in philosophical, academic, business, and analytical contexts when discussing what truly matters about something.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {核心|かくしん}: core, crux
- {真髄|しんずい}: essence, quintessence
- {根本|こんぽん}: root, foundation
